name: ourwkrp
description: Mobile-first Spotify music catalog — auth, sync, discover, create

scripts.migrate:staging: doppler run -p ourwkrp -c stg -- wrangler d1 migrations apply ourwkrp-staging --remote
scripts.migrate:prod: doppler run -p ourwkrp -c prd -- wrangler d1 migrations apply ourwkrp-production --remote --env production
scripts.predeploy:staging: npm run preflight:staging && npm run migrate:staging
scripts.deploy:staging: doppler run -p ourwkrp -c stg -- wrangler deploy
scripts.predeploy:prod: npm run preflight:prod && npm run migrate:prod
scripts.deploy:prod: doppler run -p ourwkrp -c prd -- wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.test:postman: node scripts/seed-local-d1.mjs && start-server-and-test "npx wrangler dev --port 8787" http-get://localhost:8787/health "newman run postman/ourwkrp.postman_collection.json -e postman/ourwkrp.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export postman/newman-report.html"
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
